limitations: Host conditions are joined only to complete parent worker intervals; no absolute inner API timestamps were recorded.
Guest CPU accounting and PSI do not expose physical-host frequency/cache/bandwidth or prove physical isolation.
Calling-thread service excludes pool workers and brackets wall windows, not exclusive API cycles.
Equal caller offsets do not establish identical physical/cache/dynamic-output geometry.
All metric comparisons remain unqualified; no original statistical failure is removed.
Process windows include clone/recovery/drop and all process threads; they do not locate individual allocations.
Hotspot calling-thread windows contain baseline and candidate operations while its metric describes only candidate time.
